mechanism: Cimetidine inhibits CYP450 enzymes (1A2, 2D6, 3A4) reducing chlorpromazine metabolism, leading to increased plasma concentrations and risk of toxicity.
action: Monitor for increased chlorpromazine adverse effects (sedation, orthostasis, extrapyramidal symptoms); consider dose reduction or alternative H2-blocker (famotidine, which has minimal enzyme inhibition).
